Overview of Gangwon Province Region (강원특별자치도)

Gangwon Province Region (강원특별자치도) is located in the Gangwon Province region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Chuncheon. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Seoraksan National Park, Sokcho & East Sea beaches, Gangneung coffee street & Gyeongpodae, Pyeongchang alpine resorts.

RegionGangwon Province
Capital cityChuncheon
Cities & municipalities39
Primary transport hubChuncheon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Gangwon Province Region

KTX Gangneung Line from Seoul to Pyeongchang & Gangneung (1h 30m–2h); ITX-Cheongchun to Chuncheon. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Gangwon Province

When visiting cities across Gangwon Province, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Chuncheon Dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken)
  • Makguksu (buckwheat noodles)
  • Chodang sundubu (soft tofu)
  • Sokcho dakgangjeong & stuffed squid

Best time to visit Gangwon Province

Best time to visit Gangwon Province: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov (foliage), Dec–Feb (ski).
